name: pi-vs-claude-code-vendor
description: Vendored Pi coms extensions (coms.ts + coms-net.ts) for QDS-Factory Pi swarm messaging. Loaded via `pi -e ./coms.ts`; not a published package.

_provenance.notes: themeMap.ts is a local import of coms.ts/coms-net.ts and is vendored to keep the extensions self-contained. External imports (@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent, @mariozechner/pi-tui, @sinclair/typebox) are provided by the pi runtime at load time.
